body:
Publication correction, September 25, 2026: this archive unintentionally includes four upstream 300 mV train/test example arrays through recursive vendor packaging. The documented numerical study used the four admitted 100/200 mV TRAIN members, but the broader claim that reserved files were never accessed or copied was incorrect. The original archive and its receipt remain unchanged. The new NL-LFR bundle excludes upstream examples. [Evidence and scope of the correction](https://github.com/kw2828/OpenJev/blob/main/research/fsm-author-publication-correction.md).

One FIT-only pooled author BLA28 fit and 384 causal development forecasts, with unchanged recurrent checkpoints.

Independent audit PASS: all four continuation conditions hold. BLA standardized RMSE is 0.09573; VARX96 remains the stronger linear reference at 0.05830; recurrent feedback is 0.04290. This does not reproduce the authors' periodic score or establish architectural novelty. The later NL-LFR check remained incomplete at its training cap; the scenario shift remains unexecuted.

The archive includes the initial and final fitted models, all new request inputs and forecasts, optimizer trace, qualification failures and successes, independent audit, prior comparison evidence, source code and licenses. The combined measurement archive and virtual environments are excluded, but the upstream example arrays noted above were included. The manifest contains per-file hashes; the receipt contains the archive SHA-256.

Read the report at https://github.com/kw2828/OpenJev/blob/main/research/fsm-author-bla-results.md
name: FIT-only author BLA28 comparison: audited development result
